COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar Dec-05-2005 Judgment Entered
MINI MINUTES: This matter came regularly on calendar this day, by assignment from the Department of the Presiding Judge for Court Trial/Prove-Up.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Leticia Perez.
Paul Arshawsky, Esq. for for Plaintiff: Conard House Inc.
Plaintiff's Witness: Ken Bounthavy, was sworn and direct examined.
No appearance by the Defendant: Jim Walkingbear.
Exhibit 1 - Lease Agreement-------------------------ID/EVID.
Exhibit 2 - Thirty Day Notice of Rent Increase Dtd. 9-17-02-------ID/EVID.
Exhibit 3 - Thirty Day Notice of Rent Increase Dtd. 12-22-03------ID/EVID.
Exhibit 3 - Three-Day Notice to pay of quit-----------------------ID/EVID.
After hearing the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defendant as follows:
Restitution and possession of the premises located at 240 Hyde St., #108, San Francisco.
Back Rent and Damages of $1,932.10
Costs $332.60, for a Total of $2,264.70
Rental Agreement declared forfeited.
Counsel stipulated for the return of the Exhibits in open court.
Judgment signed in open court.
